newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: DMCI units, Itochu in property jv.
newsitem.headline: DMCI units, Itochu in property jv.

text.p: Two units of construction firm DMCI Holdings Inc and Itochu Corp of Japan have decided to form a joint venture company for a residential project in Cavite, south of Manila, a company statement said.

The two units of DMCI, Universal Rightfield Property Holdings Inc and DMCI Project Developers Inc, will each own 35 percent in the new company, while Itochu will hold the remaining 30 percent, the statement on Monday said.
The three have committed to fund the development of the project which is expected to cost 389.82 million pesos, it said.
The three firms will also enter into a joint venture agreement with the owner of the 21-hectare property in Cavite.
Universal Rightfield, DMCI-Property Developers and Itochu will have a 55 percent participation in the project, while the landowner will own 45 percent, the statement added.
